text:
Sam CSM: Heads-up — CoralBridge QBR prep. Noticing a major onboarding cost spike last 2 weeks and renewal in ~6 weeks. Need a short deck + risk hotlist by EOD Friday.
Priya (RevOps): Adding. Do we have an updated spend forecast and the token-econ breakdown?
Sam CSM: I pulled a quick snapshot, see below. Main driver is embeddings-heavy indexing during onboarding.
Sam CSM: ```
7-day avg reqs: 12k/day
Embedding tokens/day: 4.2M
Gen tokens/day: 1.1M
Projected monthly run rate: ~$18k (current cadence)
Estimated onboarding delta vs baseline: +$9k/mo
```
Jon Eng: Oof. Is that steady or a ramp from a single job? Any retention of prefix/cache?
Ava SuccessEng: It's mostly a bulk reindex job per new customer workspace. Cache TTL is short — we can propose a temporary longer TTL for newly onboarded customers.
Priya (RevOps): Lina — can we offer a one-time credits/discount + throttled rollout to smooth renewal negotiations? we should quantify ROI.
Lina (AM): Yes, but need exact numbers for the account slide. If we push a limited credits package, legal ok? I'll check.
Sam CSM: For QBR deck: 1) one-slide spend trend, 2) root-cause bullets, 3) immediate mitigations (config + throttles), 4) recommended credits/commit ask.
CostBot: alert: account "coralbridge" crossed spend threshold 80% of monthly plan on 1751239000.
Jon Eng: Quick mitigation idea: change embedding batch size from 16 -> 32 and enable KV-prefix reuse for 48h. Should save ~30% token ops on reindexes. Low-risk.
Ava SuccessEng: I'll draft the config change and a one-paragraph rollback plan.
Priya (RevOps): I'll run a 3-month forecast under two scenarios: (1) throttle + config changes, (2) current cadence + one-time credits. ETA 24 hours.
Sam CSM: Great. Lina, can you prepare a short renewal note that proposes a renewal credit in exchange for enabling the throttled rollout? Keep it <=3 bullets.
Lina (AM): Yep, will DM a draft later today.
Sam CSM: Owners: Ava -> mitigation doc + rollback (by 1751239940). Priya -> forecast scenarios (by 1751239988). Lina -> renewal note (by 1751239945). I'll assemble deck.
Priya (RevOps): small ask — include per-token unit cost used in the deck. I'll use $0.0008/embedding-token and $0.00002/gen-token unless someone updates.
Jon Eng: Confirmed those unit costs are fine for the customer-facing slide.
Sam CSM: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping me and @Lina. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
